description.value: BarBurrito is a Canadian fast-casual burrito chain founded in 2005 and now operating 385+ locations across the country. The Abbotsford West Oak location serves customizable burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas made with fresh, in-house ingredients and a wide range of proteins. A touring cyclist looking for a quick, filling, customizable meal on South Fraser Way would find this a reliable stop.
